system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Acrobatics and Thievery, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Restraints Lore, Stage Mechanisms Lore, Circus Lore.
system.description: You earned your living slipping bonds and opening restraints before an audience could discover your methods. The tools you kept hidden proved useful long after a performance ended.
